rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: A. A. Kotenkov, the President's plenipotentiary representative in the State Duma, states that under Article 83(a), Article 103(1)(a) and Article 111 of the Constitution the President has submitted to the Duma the candidacy of Kiriyenko Sergei Vladilenovich for consent to his appointment as Chairman of the Government, and on the President's instruction presents him.
rows.locator: Morning session, statement of Котенков А.А. before the candidate's programme statement

rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: After deputies exchange their ordinary cards for secret-ballot cards under the Counting Commission, the Chairman puts the question 'дать согласие на назначение Сергея Владиленовича Кириенко Председателем Правительства Российской Федерации' under Article 111; the result (15:42:26) reads 143 for (31.8%), 186 against, 5 abstentions, 334 voting, 'Результат: не принято'.
rows.locator: Afternoon: card exchange and 'Результаты голосования (15 час. 42 мин. 26 сек.)'
